violated_contract: Held content with subscription UI enabled must not open a full-content destination through any row or preview tap. Obscuring the child and guarding only the action button does not guard an enclosing row recognizer.
canonical_prevention: Route the preview action and enclosing row through the same access guard, give the preview a full-area guarded tap recognizer, and test off-button taps on every preview surface with subscription UI enabled and disabled. Preserve interactive row menus and the App Review read-only memory exception.
